example_records.instruction: Analyze vector habitat risk and recommend intervention priorities for LGA North.
example_records.context: CHIRPS precipitation anomaly: +35% above seasonal average; NDVI index: high vegetative clustering in Wards 3 & 4; DHS biomarker RDT parasitemia: 28%; ITN usage: 14%.
example_records.response: Based on the elevated CHIRPS precipitation anomaly and a 28% DHS RDT parasitemia rate, LGA North Wards 3 and 4 represent an active high-risk transmission cluster. Recommended immediate action: Deploy priority buffer stocks of insecticide-treated nets (ITNs) and initiate targeted rapid diagnostic testing campaigns.

example_records.instruction: Wane ne MANI kuma ta yaya yake taimakawa ma'aikatan lafiya?
example_records.response: MANI wani tsarin fasaha ne wanda aka gina a kan N-ATLaS domin taimaka wa ma'aikatan lafiya da bayanan rarraba kayan yaki da maleriya ta hanyar amfani da bayanan tauraron dan adam da gwaje-gwajen DHS.
